name: expand-toggle-padding-token
criteria: C1: `src/DungeonMaster.App/Resources/Theme/Tokens.xaml` gains `<Thickness x:Key="DmPaddingIconToggle">2,4</Thickness>` inside the DmPadding* block (after `DmPaddingTight` at `:680` at daa819e or wherever the block's order reads best), preceded by a one-line comment in the same form as its neighbours naming the surface it pads (the floor card's expand chevron: 2 horizontal so the button hugs its glyph, 4 vertical as DmPaddingCompact has it). ExpandToggle in `src/DungeonMaster.App/Controls/FloorSidebarItem/FloorSidebarItem.xaml` (`Padding="2,4,2,4"` at `:145` at daa819e) reads `Padding="{StaticResource DmPaddingIconToggle}"`, so its rendered padding is unchanged.

C2: The fix removes the attribute-order dependency, shown by demonstration: with C1 in place, moving ExpandToggle's `Padding` attribute to the end of the element's attribute list (after `ToolTipProperties.Text`) leaves `GeometryScaleTests.NoBarePaddingValues` green; as the must-fail control, the same move applied to the base literal `Padding="2,4,2,4"` turns that fact red. Both are reverted, and every revert restores FloorSidebarItem.xaml to a sha256 equal to a scratch copy taken before it, with a control showing the comparison fires on a one-byte change.

C3: The ExpandToggle comment paragraph in FloorSidebarItem.xaml drops the sentence that begins `The padding sits high in the attribute list because` (`:132-135` at daa819e), and may say the padding comes from DmPaddingIconToggle; no other sentence in that comment changes meaning, and nothing else in the file changes.

C4: `src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Theme/ThemeDictionaryTests.cs` lists `"DmPaddingIconToggle"` with the other DmPadding* keys (`:65-66` at daa819e), so a typo in the consumed key fails a test; no other entry changes.

C5: `dotnet build src/DungeonMaster.sln` reports 0 Warning(s) and 0 Error(s) (quoted from its summary lines), and `dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.sln` passes every test in every test project, with counts named per project; the baseline is the 1004, 217 and 146 that session 20261113-1727-icon-button-follow-ups recorded at 9c2f1e4 (labelled, not re-measured at daa819e, which changes no src file after it), and any difference is explained.

C6: Every touched file keeps its line endings, BOM state and indentation: at daa819e FloorSidebarItem.xaml is 397/397 CRLF with a BOM, Tokens.xaml 725/725 CRLF no BOM, ThemeDictionaryTests.cs 474/474 CRLF no BOM, none with a lone CR (Python `b.count(b'\r\n')`, `b.count(b'\n')`, `b.count(b'\r')`); after the change each is all-CRLF with CR count equal to CRLF count, BOM state unchanged, the XAML files space-indented and the .cs file tab-indented.

escalations.question: How should ExpandToggle's literal Padding="2,4,2,4" stop depending on GeometryScaleTests' 8-line comment window: a named Thickness token, widening HasDocumentingComment to measure from the element's start tag, or leaving it?
escalations.answer: Named token (DmPaddingIconToggle in Tokens.xaml, referenced by StaticResource), asked at Gate 1 with the track confirmation.
